rules.machine_rule: The current opposite-direction candle body contains the entire previous body; the previous body is the zone and becomes observable only at current close.
Do not chase before the zone revisit; invalidate beyond the two-candle formation extreme. Full exit at first pre-existing wave liquidity is permitted.
Identify stop-cluster liquidity first, require interaction, then use the body-engulf order block as a distinct confirmation.
A break that fails acceptance and closes back inside can reverse toward the opposite structure; invalidation is beyond the excursion extreme.
After a boundary break, trade the first role-reversal revisit when it overlaps the source-defined order block.
An unfinished candle is not an order block; larger timeframes define context/liquidity and 5m defines the first executable state transition.
